novel claim: the workspace band for image-position content is delayed/absent relative to text positions — obj_img should stay ~0 at ALL layers while obj_txt rises through the band (prior evidence: image-position readouts stay object-free at all layers)

notes.band_stats: next-token top-k accuracy: teacher-forced, position p predicts ids[p+1] (the last prompt position has no in-prompt successor and is excluded); readout excess kurtosis: mean over the modality's positions of kurtosis(logit_row) - 3; top-1 stickiness: P(top1[p+1] == top1[p]) over positionally consecutive same-modality positions, vs a shuffled null (the modality's top-1 ids permuted over its positions, the same pair set recomputed; analytic permutation mean + empirical std over --n-null-shuffles per image); effective dimensionality: participation ratio of the covariance of the category J-lens vectors (position-independent)
notes.topk: top-k = the k highest calibrated J-lens logits at the position; membership counts a token's emission id (last subword of ' ' + name) among the k ids
notes.modality_split: image = the 576 placeholder positions; text = all non-image non-bos prompt positions (x16's groups; the bos position belongs to neither split); all statistics use the calibrated J-lens readout at each position

interpretation_limits: next-token accuracy is teacher-forced over in-prompt successors: at image positions the target is almost always the next placeholder id, so the image-side accuracy measures placeholder predictability, not object knowledge — the object_in_top10_rate columns carry the modality claim
the top-1 stickiness null is a permutation of the modality's own top-1 sequence, so it controls for the token marginals but not for position semantics
effective dimensionality is position-independent by construction (the category J-lens vector matrix); it is reported per layer for completeness only
the captioning prompt's text positions are few (~20 per image), so text-side pools are ~30x smaller than image-side pools per image
the tiny backend is a random-weight fixture: it exercises the machinery, its rates do not transfer to the real model
